neighbours.label: A point or stretch in time is being located: time-locating tokens such as 'during', 'until', a year or decade, 'N years later', as opposed to locating something in space
fire: The library was founded in 1902, but it did not admit readers until three decades later.
Snow closes the pass during the coldest weeks of January.
My grandfather still talks about the summer of 1976.
Most of the songs were written in the early 1980s, before the band split.
The couple married in Rome and moved to Lisbon six years later.
Tourists crowd the beaches during the hottest part of August.
The vote was delayed for months and did not happen until the following spring.
She recalled the harsh winter of 1947 with a shudder.
quiet: The library was founded by a banker, but it did not admit readers from the north side.
